backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling feature requests, user profiles, announcements, storage, and access control with various data types and authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing required frontend modifications and behaviors for NotesCleanerPage with associated components and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of multiple frontend source files and components.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Stores the numeric draft version used for production promotion.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documentation describing production promotion rules and constraints for the CI/CD system.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base file defining design tokens, dark mode variables, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes, theme provider, layout, and global toaster.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Large multilingual assignment assistant chatbot with text, voice, OCR, file download, and message handling features.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main site layout with header navigation, mobile sheet menu, routed content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable button component supporting variants, sizes, and optional child wrapping.
Provides styled card components including header, title, description, content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Implements a slide-over sheet with context-based open state, trigger, content, and helpers.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder toaster component that renders nothing.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: Implements an AI assistant UI with messaging, speech input, OCR loading, auto‑scrolling, and assignment-generation workflows.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Notes that DailyProgressChart.tsx must remain unchanged as it already functions correctly.
Renders a daily progress donut chart and stats based on completed, pending, and total task durations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Selects and displays either the daily or weekly progress chart based on view type.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Displays a colored subject badge using mapped subject color classes.
Dropdown component that filters and selects subjects with search support and count display.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: Displays weekly task stats and completion breakdown using a donut chart and summary grid.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for feature requests, assignment helpers, conversation saving, and study planner task mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: Stores and restores the study planner’s sort mode using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: Manages daily and weekly subject filters separately and persists them to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: Stores and retrieves the user’s preferred study planner view (daily or weekly) using localStorage.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors, layout, and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
Provides a full assignment formatting tool with multilingual UI text, customization options, and an editor with AI and download features.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section and a grid of tool cards that navigate to various student utilities.
Generates a formatted leave application letter based on user inputs and supports copying the result.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Cleans and reformats rough notes using selectable formatting options and supports copying or downloading the output.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Lets users submit new feature requests with optional email and sends the data through a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: React page for building a simple resume with personal details, education, skills, projects, and copy-to-clipboard generation.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: Main Study Planner UI managing tasks, authentication modes, sorting, filtering, and task creation for daily/weekly views.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Provides bullet style configuration and prefix generation, currently fixed to dash style.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Utilities for detecting paragraphs, splitting sentences, definition-style formatting, and normalizing lines for notes cleaning.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Generates filenames and triggers TXT downloads for cleaned notes with auto-naming logic.
Parses duration strings into minutes and formats minute values back into readable duration text.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages Study Planner guest-mode tasks using localStorage with add, load, toggle, delete, and clear functions.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Generates printable HTML for exporting study tasks as a PDF-like document and opens a print window. Includes task formatting, summaries, and styling.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting for study tasks by date/time or ID with stable ordering. Supports both backend and guest task types.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Converts and formats optional date/time fields for study tasks, supporting bigint and number timestamps. Includes helpers for parsing input and producing display strings.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Builds and downloads a plain-text export of study tasks with headers, summaries, and formatted task details. Uses Blob download to create a .txt file.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Handles weekly date calculations and normalization for study tasks, including unwrapping optional dates and detecting week boundaries. Supports bigint nanosecond and number millisecond inputs.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Maps subjects to predefined color names and returns corresponding badge and indicator CSS classes. Provides helpers for persisted and derived subject colors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both query and hash routing. Includes sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, content scanning, extended color/theme settings using CSS variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing UI enhancements for the Cleaned Notes panel, including new controls, reset behaviors, and TXT download naming rules.
unknown.txt: Specification of a fixed assignment editor format with download options, subject insertion tools, autosave, and an embedded context-aware 'Student Sathi Assistant' chat module with strict UI behavior.
